premises.text: Mobile device users need a better power solution than hunting for outlets
premises.evidence_span: scurrying around trying to find an outlet just to get a little bit more juice in your phone

premises.text: A proprietary harvesting antenna in a phone case captures wasted RF from the phone and converts it into electricity returned to the battery, extending life passively without plugging in
premises.evidence_span: Our case is embedded with a harvesting antenna that is proprietary that captures that wasted RF energy and then takes it through a conversion process to convert it into electricity and then dumps it back into the phone

premises.text: A smartphone case is the right first product because many US smartphone users already buy power accessories
premises.evidence_span: out of the 220 million smartphone users in the United States, over 30% have purchased some sort of product to help them get a little more power in their phone

premises.text: Partnership with Ohio State as a leading RF research institution enables pioneering and bringing the technology to market quickly
premises.evidence_span: We partnered with Ohio State because they are the leading RF research institution, academic institution, in the United States

premises.text: A follow-on wireless charger will provide near-field and far-field powering where consumers are
premises.evidence_span: Our next product that we're going to bring to the market is a wireless charger that will provide near field and far field powering solutions

premises.text: Low-power IoT sensors can live entirely by harvesting ambient RF energy without battery changes
premises.evidence_span: low power sensors that can live 100% off of our technology

premises.text: The case launches to consumers through Kickstarter
premises.evidence_span: in one month, we are launching this product. And we will be doing that on Kickstarter
